verdict.rationale: Raygun documents an export feature that lets customers export all or selected error groups from the Crash Reporting dashboard. The changelog also shows CSV (an open format) exports that follow applied filters, so some data can be taken out in open formats. However, the evidence covers only parts of the product, not a complete account-wide export for leaving. Missing for 10: export of all data across every product (APM, RUM, raw error instances), documented export formats beyond CSV, bulk or API-driven full export, and account-closure or data-deletion guidance.
